subject.name: Ali Ahmed
subject.fictionalNotice: Strictly Fictional Character for Educational Purposes
subject.bio: CS student | Tech enthusiast | Coffee addict ☕ | Building cool things with code | Always on the go 🚀
subject.summary: Ali is an active student who regularly documents his daily campus journey online. While his posts seem completely harmless to friends, malicious actors can piece together an alarming amount of personal information.

objectives: Identify daily schedule and lecture hall routine exposures
Detect habitual hangout and location pattern vulnerabilities
Uncover high-risk credential and student badge leakage
Spot physical absence and residential vulnerability windows
Extract embedded EXIF geolocation and hardware metadata
Navigate real-world privacy dilemmas under social pressure
